paragraphs: A Land Rover Ford Duratorq engine rebuild starts from £1,900, regardless of which of the four models it's fitted to — the price tier is set by the engine, not the model. A full replacement engine and fitting service is also available.

cards.title: Rebuilding Your
cards.body: Most engine suppliers sell you a used engine of unknown history and hope it matches. We rebuild the engine your Land Rover already has instead — strip it down, pressure-test it, and replace every worn or damaged component with updated OEM parts. You get a near-new engine with a 12-month unlimited-mileage warranty, without the compatibility risk of an unknown used unit. This is the option most Ford Duratorq owners choose.

cards.title: Replacement
cards.body: If your existing engine is beyond economical repair, we also offer full engine replacement and fitting — sourced and fitted by our team, with the same 12-month unlimited-mileage warranty.

cards.title: Used
cards.body: In some cases, a matched low-mileage used engine is the right call — particularly if you need your car back on the road quickly and your existing engine's damage is extensive. We can source and fit these too, though most owners who ask about used engines end up choosing a rebuild once they understand the compatibility risk a used unit carries.

options.body: "Reconditioned" is the term many owners search for when they mean the same thing as a rebuild — a full strip-down, inspection, and replacement of worn parts rather than a straight swap. If that's what you're after, our rebuild service is exactly that.
"Refurbished" often describes the same process from a different angle — restoring your existing engine to full working condition rather than replacing it outright. Our rebuild covers this.

Some owners specifically search for a "remanufactured" engine, expecting a unit rebuilt to original specification with updated components. That's consistent with what our rebuild service delivers, regardless of which of the six Ford Duratorq-equipped models you drive.

faqLeft.q: What is the Land Rover Ford Duratorq engine?
faqLeft.a: The Duratorq is a Ford-sourced 2.2-litre four-cylinder diesel engine (Puma family), used in Land Rover applications between 2011 and 2016. It's a chain-driven engine fitted across the Defender, Discovery Sport, Freelander and Range Rover Evoque.

faqLeft.q: Which Land Rover models use the Ford Duratorq?
faqLeft.a: Defender (L663 Puma, 2012–2016), Discovery Sport (L550, 2014–2016), Freelander (L359, 2011–2014) and Range Rover Evoque (L538, 2011–2016) — see the full applications table above for exact variants and years.

faqLeft.q: Does the Duratorq differ between Land Rover models?
faqLeft.a: Yes. The specific ancillaries, mounting, and turbo configuration differ by application, even though the base engine family is the same. We match by registration/VIN before confirming any rebuild or replacement.

faqLeft.q: Is a Duratorq from one Land Rover model compatible with another?
faqLeft.a: Not automatically. A Duratorq from a Defender isn't a drop-in match for a Duratorq from a Range Rover Evoque — ancillaries, mounting, and turbo configuration all differ. We always confirm compatibility by registration/VIN.

faqLeft.q: How much does a Land Rover Ford Duratorq engine rebuild cost?
faqLeft.a: Rebuilds start from £1,900, regardless of which model it's fitted to. Exact price depends on condition and parts required — submit your reg for a fixed-price quote.
Yes. We work on Duratorq rebuilds across every Land Rover model it's fitted to, replacing worn components as standard.

faqLeft.q: What are the common issues with the Land Rover Duratorq?
faqLeft.a: Confirmed issues include EGR cooler failure (which can cause milky oil), turbo actuator failure (causing restricted performance and limp home mode), timing chain tensioner wear, injector seal problems, and the interlinked EGR/DPF/VNT turbo carbon-choke system on EU5 engines.

faqRight.q: Can you rebuild a Duratorq from a Discovery Sport?
faqRight.a: Yes. The Duratorq in the Discovery Sport is one of the applications we work on — the TD4 and SD4 variants from the 2014–2016 production window.

faqRight.q: Can you rebuild a Duratorq from a Range Rover Evoque?
faqRight.a: Yes. The Duratorq in the Range Rover Evoque is one of the applications we work on — the TD4 and SD4 variants from the 2011–2016 first-generation L538 production.

faqRight.q: Do you supply used Land Rover Ford Duratorq engines?
faqRight.a: Yes, in some cases a matched low-mileage used engine is the right option. Our team will advise honestly once we've matched your registration and understood your situation.

faqRight.q: Can you recover my Land Rover if the engine has failed?
faqRight.a: Yes — nationwide recovery is available from £70, and most vehicles are collected within a few hours of booking.

faqRight.q: How long does a Duratorq engine rebuild take?
faqRight.a: Most rebuilds are completed within 3-5 working days from the time your vehicle arrives at our workshop.

faqRight.q: Is rebuilding better than fitting a used engine?
faqRight.a: For most Duratorq owners, yes. A rebuild removes the compatibility risk that comes with an unknown used unit's history — a particular concern given how many different Duratorq applications exist across the Land Rover range — and comes with a 12-month unlimited-mileage warranty.
